placement_summary: Sultai Brood is a source-bound live pilot. Its strongest placement signals are Black-centered BGU Tarkir identity, ruthlessness, resource conversion, necromancy, sibsig labor, Sidisi-era ambition, Silumgar boundary, modern Dragonstorm timeline labeling, and false-positive boundaries against generic BGU, Commander products, color-philosophy proof, Dragonstorm backfill, and seed files.

moral_and_psychological_profile.summary: Vox Mana models Sultai as ruthlessness through resource conversion: opportunity, bodies, land, secrets, costs, and the dead become usable material under Black ambition and Blue calculation. This is project interpretation from normalized SULTAI evidence plus VM-210/VM-211 shaping docs, not official canon, and VM-214 keeps it preview-ineligible while enabling live placement.
moral_and_psychological_profile.notes: Psychological language is Vox Mana synthesis. Support-only rows do not raise confidence.

core_values.label: Ruthless Opportunity
core_values.description: Advantage is taken because it is available, and costs are acceptable when they move the goal closer.

core_values.description: Theft, resource denial, mind pressure, planning, spies, scouts, and terrain knowledge shape Sultai as selective rather than merely hungry.
